heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly sunny, except increasing clouds in the St. Lawrence Valley. Highs from the mid 60s to around 70. South to southwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph from the Green Mountains westward.

heading: Tonight
text: Partly to mostly cloudy. Chance of showers near and north of Route 2, slight chance to south. Lows in the mid to upper 40s. South winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph west of the Greens.

heading: Friday
text: Partly cloudy south. Mostly cloudy north, with a chance of sprinkles, mainly over high terrain. Highs in the low to mid 50s north, and upper 50s to lower 60s in the south, with some mid 60s possible in southeastern valleys. West to northwest winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.
